description: This header file contains inline utility functions for file operations, property reading, content fetching, file type checking, recursive file searching with pattern matching, and property expansion within strings. It is part of the Utils namespace and provides core utility functions used across the project.

methods.name: bool readPropertyFromFile(const char * filename,const string & property,string & propertyValue)
methods.description: Reads a property value from a specified file, supporting recursive expansion if the value starts with '$'.

methods.name: bool readFileContent(const char * filename,string & content)
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file into a string.

methods.name: bool isRegularFile(const string & path)
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a regular file.

methods.name: bool searchFilesRec(std::vector<std::string> & pathList,unsigned int currentDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Performs recursive search for files and directories matching patterns, respecting exclusions and depth limits.

methods.name: bool searchFiles(string & inputPath,int maxDepth,int minDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Initiates recursive search for files starting from a specified path, with max/min depth and exclusions.

methods.name: bool ExpandPropertiesInString(const char * input,const char * filePath,string & expandedString)
methods.description: Expands variable placeholders in a string by reading corresponding values from a property file.
